name: astral-skills
description: Personal collection of vendored Claude Code skills, organized by category (general, frontend, security, devtools). Add this marketplace once in any repo, then install just the skills you want.

metadata.description: Vendored skills from their upstream repos, pruned to just the SKILL.md content. See the root README.md for full attribution, caveats, and per-skill notes.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Makes Claude write like 'the laziest senior dev' - reuses stdlib/existing code before writing new code. Ships 6 sub-skills (ponytail, review, audit, debt, gain, help).

plugins.name: karpathy-skills
plugins.description: Andrej Karpathy's 4 rules for LLM coding pitfalls: surface assumptions, minimal diffs, surgical edits only, verifiable success criteria.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's real .agents directory: 50+ skills for TDD, code review, domain modeling, architecture.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: Everything Claude Code - large agent-harness system: skills, instincts, memory, security, research-first workflow.

plugins.name: claude-mem
plugins.description: Persistent memory across sessions - captures what an agent did, compresses it, re-injects relevant context into future sessions.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Compresses agent output/context ~65-75% by talking in terse 'caveman' prose while keeping code/commands/errors byte-exact.

plugins.name: planning-with-files
plugins.description: Manus-style persistent markdown planning - crash-proof task plans that survive /clear and context compaction.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Searchable databases of UI styles, color palettes, font pairings, and UX guidelines to ground design decisions. 7 sub-skills.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Stops AI from generating generic 'slop' frontends - layout, typography, spacing, hierarchy, motion guidance. Multiple style variants.

plugins.name: superdesign
plugins.description: Gives the agent design judgment so UI ships 'tasteful' instead of generic-AI-looking.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Catalogs 64+ 'AI slop' design patterns (purple gradients, generic defaults) and replaces them. Commands: craft, audit, polish, harden.

plugins.name: design-motion
plugins.description: Motion design skill with two modes: build components with purposeful motion, or audit existing animations.

plugins.name: figma-implement
plugins.description: Translates a Figma design into production code with 1:1 visual fidelity. Needs a Figma MCP/API connection.

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Pre-indexed, auto-syncing local code knowledge graph - fewer tokens/tool-calls to understand a codebase.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Turns a folder of code/docs/PDFs/images into a queryable, deterministic (AST-based) knowledge graph. Note: ships a lowercase skill.md, not SKILL.md - verify it loads before relying on it.

plugins.name: firecrawl
plugins.description: Web scraping/crawling/search as Claude Code commands+skills, backed by the Firecrawl API. Needs FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.

plugins.name: codex-plugin-cc
plugins.description: Lets Claude Code delegate a task or code review to OpenAI Codex. Needs a ChatGPT sub or OpenAI API key.

plugins.name: claude-hud
plugins.description: Local-only HUD plugin: live view of context usage, active tools, running agents, todo progress. No network calls.

plugins.name: wshobson-agents
plugins.description: Large multi-harness collection: subagents, skills, commands, and plugins across every domain (backend, frontend, mobile, etc.).

plugins.name: prompt-master
plugins.description: Writes accurate, tool-specific prompts for 30+ AI tools from a short brief; keeps a memory block of prior decisions.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Discover and install Claude Code skills from 12 community/official sources without leaving the CLI.

plugins.name: agent-skills-cli
plugins.description: The generic 'npx skills' installer - auto-detects your agent and installs a skill in the right place/format.

plugins.name: gstack
plugins.description: Garry Tan's full virtual-engineering-team setup: role skills (CEO, eng manager, designer, QA, security, release) + power tools.

plugins.name: omniroute
plugins.description: Local AI-gateway routing to many providers/models with auto-fallback. CAUTION: independent coverage has flagged security issues/CVEs on this project - review before running.
